systemPage.mode_dual_desc: Publishes in both formats for maximum compatibility
systemPage.mode_dual_tip: Every update is published in both formats. Suits mixed plants with legacy SCADA and Sparkplug B systems.
systemPage.mode_sparkplug_desc: Saves bandwidth with Report by Exception (RBE)
systemPage.mode_sparkplug_tip: Eclipse Sparkplug B industrial standard. Publishes only when the value changes, which cuts network traffic sharply.
systemPage.mode_legacy_tip: Publishes only in the internal JSON format. For systems without Sparkplug B support, or for debugging.

systemPage.broker_external_desc: Use an MQTT broker you already have
systemPage.client_id_hint: Unique identifier for this MQTT connection

systemPage.publish_desc: How the PLC drivers publish values
systemPage.hb_on_change: Publishes only when the value moves beyond the deadband.
systemPage.hb_realtime: Publishes on every read (real time): RBE is off.
systemPage.hb_interval: How often the value is republished even when it does not change.
systemPage.deadband_hint: Minimum change before an analog value is published.
systemPage.write_age: How long PLC commands stay valid
systemPage.write_age_hint: A setpoint or command older than this is rejected, not executed, and the operator sees why. This matters when the link to a box drops: commands given in the meantime are not executed hours later, when the line comes back. From 5 to 3600 seconds; 30 is right almost always.
systemPage.db_retention_hint: How many days historical data is kept in the PostgreSQL database. Older data is deleted automatically to free disk space.
systemPage.db_retention_warn: Warning: 0 (forever) turns off automatic cleanup, and the disk can fill up.
systemPage.manual_backup_desc: Create and download a backup now
systemPage.db_stats_desc: Live PostgreSQL figures, refreshed every 60 s
systemPage.hist_retention_desc: How many days to keep historian data (0 = cleanup off)
systemPage.hist_retention_warn: Deleted data cannot be recovered. Make sure you have a backup before reducing retention.
systemPage.cli_desc: Run these on the host where Docker runs
systemPage.sso_desc: Set up Google and Azure AD single sign-on for the organization's users.
systemPage.sso_callbacks: Callback URLs (enter these in your provider)
systemPage.footer_tagline: — IIoT solutions for real-time monitoring and historian storage of industrial plants.
systemPage.influx_desc: Forwards tag history to an InfluxDB v2 bucket using the line protocol. Data is sent in batches every N seconds.
systemPage.hist_retention_hint: Every day the cleanup job deletes rows older than this from tag_history. Set 0 to turn it off.

backup.title: Automatic backup
backup.desc: Scheduled PostgreSQL dumps · age encryption · SHA-256 integrity · optional S3/MinIO offsite copy
backup.auto_off: When off, only manual backups are possible.
backup.retention_hint: Older backups are deleted automatically. 30 days recommended.
backup.encryption_hint: Enter an age public key to encrypt every dump. Generate it offline: age-keygen -o age-key.txt. Each backup automatically gets a .sha256 file to verify its integrity.
backup.encryption_empty: Empty = unencrypted dumps (acceptable when the backup folder is on an encrypted disk).
backup.endpoint: Custom endpoint (MinIO / Cloudflare R2 — leave empty for AWS)
backup.offsite_hint: After each scheduled backup, the dump and its .sha256 file are uploaded to S3. Restart the backup container after saving to apply the changes.

notificationsSettings.err_to: At least one recipient is required
notificationsSettings.title: Notifications
notificationsSettings.desc: Send alarms by email, Telegram, Slack, Teams or PagerDuty. Configure once: every alarm at or above the chosen severity is sent automatically.
notificationsSettings.min_severity_hint: Events below this level are not sent.
notificationsSettings.rate_hint: Cap across all channels: protects against flapping sensors.
notificationsSettings.on_cleared_off: Only when the alarm goes active
notificationsSettings.gmail_hint: Gmail: use an <link>app password</link>, not your account password.
notificationsSettings.tls_hint: On = port 465 (full TLS). Off = port 587 (STARTTLS, recommended).
notificationsSettings.tg_setup: One-time setup: talk to @BotFather → /newbot → paste the token below. Add the bot to a group (or DM it), then open {{url}} to read the chat.id (negative for groups, positive for DMs).
notificationsSettings.slack_setup: In Slack, create an app → Incoming Webhooks → Activate → Add to channel → copy the URL below.
notificationsSettings.teams_setup: In Teams, open a channel → ··· → Connectors → Incoming Webhook → Configure → copy the URL below.
notificationsSettings.pd_setup: PagerDuty → Services → Integrations → Add Integration → Events API v2 → copy the Routing Key below. Alarms open incidents; when the alarm clears, the incident resolves itself.
notificationsSettings.test_ok: Test message delivered to every enabled channel.
